subject.title: [Feature]: LLM distillation/extraction gate for memory-core deep-phase promotion (distill, don't dump raw snippets into MEMORY.md)

question: Should memory-core grow an opt-in LLM distillation gate before deep-phase writes to MEMORY.md, or should durable-memory quality move through the human-reviewed Memory Audit direction instead?
rationale: The request is plausible but changes the product contract for durable memory writes, adds model-dependent behavior, and likely introduces new config semantics; source inspection shows no existing implementation to cleanup-close.

options.title: Favor review queue first
options.body: Keep the current bounded promotion path and evaluate Memory Audit or another human-reviewed lane as the safer durable-memory quality path before adding automatic model rewrites.

options.title: Add opt-in distillation gate
options.body: Accept a memory-core feature that distills candidates before write, with explicit config, trust/model-unavailable behavior, docs, and focused upgrade-safe tests.

options.title: Decline automatic distillation
options.body: Close the direction as not planned and point users to manual curation, Memory Wiki, Honcho, or Memory Audit-style review instead of model-backed auto-write behavior.

recommendation.title: Favor review queue first
recommendation.body: Keep the current bounded promotion path and evaluate Memory Audit or another human-reviewed lane as the safer durable-memory quality path before adding automatic model rewrites.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current dreaming promotion flow and are the clearest owner trail for deciding whether this write path should change.
